usage: run_session_pool_eval.py [-h] [--dataset {vctk,librispeech}]
                                --session_pool_csv SESSION_POOL_CSV
                                --method_name METHOD_NAME
                                [--defense_checkpoint DEFENSE_CHECKPOINT]
                                [--max_utters MAX_UTTERS]
                                [--quality_max_utters QUALITY_MAX_UTTERS]
                                [--group_key {auto,utter_id,session_id}]
                                [--compute_quality]
                                [--sanity_output SANITY_OUTPUT]
                                [--sanity_stats_output SANITY_STATS_OUTPUT]
                                [--sanity_n_sessions SANITY_N_SESSIONS]
                                [--sanity_random_trials SANITY_RANDOM_TRIALS]
                                [--seed SEED] [--k_list K_LIST]
                                [--strategies STRATEGIES]
                                [--targeted_selection_source {clean,defended,tele_defended}]
                                [--telephony_config TELEPHONY_CONFIG]
                                [--eval_config EVAL_CONFIG]
                                [--speaker_encoder_name SPEAKER_ENCODER_NAME]
                                [--speaker_checkpoint_dir SPEAKER_CHECKPOINT_DIR]
                                [--speaker_checkpoint_dir_xvector SPEAKER_CHECKPOINT_DIR_XVECTOR]
                                [--telephony_codec {none,opus,g711}]
                                [--telephony_codec_bitrate TELEPHONY_CODEC_BITRATE]
                                [--output_tag OUTPUT_TAG]

Session-pool eval (random_K + bestK).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --dataset {vctk,librispeech}
  --session_pool_csv SESSION_POOL_CSV
  --method_name METHOD_NAME
  --defense_checkpoint DEFENSE_CHECKPOINT
  --max_utters MAX_UTTERS
  --quality_max_utters QUALITY_MAX_UTTERS
  --group_key {auto,utter_id,session_id}
  --compute_quality
  --sanity_output SANITY_OUTPUT
  --sanity_stats_output SANITY_STATS_OUTPUT
  --sanity_n_sessions SANITY_N_SESSIONS
  --sanity_random_trials SANITY_RANDOM_TRIALS
  --seed SEED
  --k_list K_LIST
  --strategies STRATEGIES
                        Main: random_K,bestK_by_self_consistency. Legacy
                        oracle:
                        bestK_by_clean_consistency,bestK_by_ref_similarity
                        with source clean.
  --targeted_selection_source {clean,defended,tele_defended}
                        Selection observations: tele_defended (main), defended
                        (pre-channel ablation), clean (oracle reference). Also
                        applies to self-consistency.
  --telephony_config TELEPHONY_CONFIG
  --eval_config EVAL_CONFIG
  --speaker_encoder_name SPEAKER_ENCODER_NAME
  --speaker_checkpoint_dir SPEAKER_CHECKPOINT_DIR
  --speaker_checkpoint_dir_xvector SPEAKER_CHECKPOINT_DIR_XVECTOR
  --telephony_codec {none,opus,g711}
  --telephony_codec_bitrate TELEPHONY_CODEC_BITRATE
  --output_tag OUTPUT_TAG
